target: Use complete counts instead of vivid distractors
prompt: Select the route using the complete log. Return only the structured response: schemaVersion 0.1.0, this caseId, status ANSWER with selectedOptionId, or status ABSTAIN.
context: Complete log: route E had 2 delays in 100 trips; route F had 10 in 100. A vivid story describes one E delay. Select the lower observed delay proportion.

options.text: Route F because the E story is vivid.

limitations: Closed supplied context and exact option selection only; no broad ability, diagnosis, or scientific validity inference.
